exposure: Dichorionic-diamniotic twin pregnancies complicated by preeclampsia
outcome: Placental histopathological lesions (maternal vascular malperfusion lesions, fetal vascular supply lesions)
cohort: The study participants included singleton and dichorionic-diamniotic twin pregnancies complicated by preeclampsia between January 2008 and October 2016.
finding: Placentas from singleton pregnancies complicated by preeclampsia were characterized by higher rates of maternal and fetal vascular lesions compared to those from twin pregnancies, suggesting different underlying mechanisms for preeclampsia in these two groups.
birth_weight: Used to define Small for Gestational Age (SGA) as birth weight <=10th percentile.
gest_age: Higher gestational age was observed in the singleton group; gestational age is also inherent in the definition of SGA.
